## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the trigger, previous behavior and what changes. Link the tracking issue.

## Validation

List the actual OS/architecture/toolchain, commands and results. Distinguish
passing checks from checks not run. Link the CI run. Explain new regression tests.

## Risks and support scope

Describe compatibility effects, cleanup/error paths, remaining limitations and
any new dependencies. State whether package contents or installation change.

- [ ] The diff stays within the stated scope.
- [ ] A regression covers the fix where meaningful.
- [ ] Platform/support documentation and changelog are consistent.
- [ ] No credentials, generated binaries or unrelated formatting are included.
- [ ] Network tests are bounded and isolated; no raw traffic engine was run.
